## What is Positron? {.center}

A free fork of Visual Studio Code purpose-built for **data science**

|  | VS Code | RStudio | **Positron** |
|--|---------|---------|----------|
| **Built for** | Software Developers | Data Scientists | Data Scientists |

::: {.callout-tip}
Get it at [positron.posit.co](https://positron.posit.co)
:::

---

## Hello Positron

Positron gives data scientists a unified environment to:

- **Write** code (R and Python)
- **Run** analyses interactively
- **Manage** packages and environments
- **Understand** data with dedicated panes
- **AI** assistance built in

## AI with Positron: Posit Assistant

An **AI client within Positron** that adapts LLMs to data science. It:

1. Provides **data science skills** — curated context for R, Python, and Posit tools
2. Encourages a **code-first, token-saving** method
3. Organizes access to your **Positron, R, and Python sessions**

---

## Posit Assistant: Works Where You Work

Posit Assistant is not Positron-only — it runs across multiple environments:

| Platform | Notes |
|----------|-------|
| **Positron** | Pre-installed in recent versions |
| **RStudio** | Latest release; includes Next-Edit Suggestions |
| **Terminal** | `pa` TUI for interactive or headless use |

---

## Power Positron with Your Preferred LLM

Posit Assistant works with the LLMs you already use:

- OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, …)
- Anthropic Claude
- GitHub Copilot
- Google Gemini
- Local models (Ollama)
- …and more

## Follow Along: Assess Data Quality

Open Posit Assistant in the sidebar and ask:

> *Load the data in `credit_raw.csv`. What is the lowest age in the data set? The highest?*

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
⏱️ 4 minutes
:::

---

## Posit Assistant Reads Your Session

Posit Assistant connects to your **live R and Python sessions** and sees:

- **Loaded packages** — knows what's available without being told
- **Data frames in memory** — understands your data's structure
- **Console history** — picks up where you left off

Generated code works with your actual environment, not a generic example.

---

## The WEAR Philosophy

::: {.callout-important}
**Code is the most auditable way to explore data with AI.**
:::

Posit Assistant emphasizes a **code-first** workflow:

- Every result is backed by **reproducible code**
- Skills and context shape the AI's behavior
- You stay in control — the AI follows your lead

---

## Prompt Advice

For each prompt, explain:

| Element | Purpose | Example |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **Why** | Your ultimate goal | *"I want to understand loan risk…"* |
| **What** | Clear instructions | *"Fit a logistic regression…"* |
| **How** | Tools to use | *"…using the `stats` package"* |

Good prompts → better, more targeted code.

---

## Modes: Built-in Behavior for Different Tasks

Posit Assistant has **specialized modes** that adapt its behavior:

- 🧹 **Cleaning mode** — systematic data auditing and tidying
- 📊 **Analysis mode** — exploration and visualization
- 🔧 **General mode** — writing and debugging code

---

## Your Turn: Clean the Data {background-color="#1B998B"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
⏱️ 6 minutes
:::

Open Posit Assistant and choose **Cleaning mode**. Ask it to:

> *Clean the data in `credit_raw.csv`. Save the clean version of the data as `credit.csv`.*

---

## Your Turn: Build a Predictive Model {background-color="#1B998B"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
⏱️ 6 minutes
:::

Clear the variables. Then ask Posit Assistant:

> *I'm trying to understand the factors associated with loan delinquencies. Please load `credit.csv`. Then fit a simple logistic regression to the data that uses `serious_dlqin_2yrs` as a response variable. Use the `stats` (R) / `statsmodels` (Python) package.*

Follow up until you understand what the model says.

## Memory: AGENTS.md

Posit Assistant can remember context across sessions via **AGENTS.md** files:

- **User-level** (`~/.posit/assistant/AGENTS.md`) — personal preferences
- **Project-level** (`AGENTS.md` in repo root) — project facts, data schemas, conventions

::: {.callout-tip}
Full docs: [assistant.posit.co/docs/features/memory](https://assistant.posit.co/docs/features/memory/)
:::

---

## Skills

Skills provide **curated domain knowledge** to the assistant:

- Data cleaning, visualization, modeling
- Package-specific guidance (tidymodels, scikit-learn, bslib, …)
- Custom skills for your organization

## Your Turn: Explore Model Results {background-color="#1B998B"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
⏱️ 7 minutes
:::

Begin exploring the model with visuals or tables. Pick one prompt and iterate:

- *Draw an ROC curve for the model.*
- *Use `gt` (R) or `great_tables` (Python) to make a table listing the odds ratio for each predictor.*
- *Use `ggplot2` (R) or `plotnine` (Python) to make a calibration plot for the model.*

---

## Slash Commands

Posit Assistant responds to `/` commands for common tasks:

| Command | What it does |
|---------|-------------|
| `/report` | Generate a Quarto document (`.qmd`) |
| `/notebook` | Generate a Jupyter notebook (`.ipynb`) |
| `/plan` | Design an approach before writing code |
| `/compact` | Summarize the conversation to reduce token usage |

Both output commands capture your code in a fully **editable, reproducible** format.

---

## Your Turn: Save Your Work {background-color="#1B998B"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
⏱️ 5 minutes
:::

Run `/report` or `/notebook` in Posit Assistant to save your code. Then:

- **Quarto**: Click **Preview** at the top of the file
- **Notebook**: Click **Run All Cells**
